hook: A friendly town map with twelve places, from the bakery to the fire station. Tap to hear the words, answer "I need a book. Where do I go?" and match each helper to where they work.
outcome: Name places and helpers in a community and use sentence frames to say where to go and who works there
sources: Buildings drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
Helpers illustrated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
